content: Recharts v2 (latest 2.12 early 2026) with Next.js App Router: Must be a Client Component (add 'use client'). ResponsiveContainer has SSR issues — it needs to measure DOM dimensions which don't exist on server. Fix: use next/dynamic with { ssr: false } OR provide explicit width/height to ResponsiveContainer. Recharts ships its own TypeScript types. Stable API, rare breaking changes. For financial charts: BarChart, LineChart, AreaChart, and PieChart cover all common needs.
